task.objective: Protect the recovered Player, Functor, and Small score floor, then improve only through serial Runtime-verified proof batches.
gates: Runtime executes lake build directly without a shell pipeline
Root cannot edit benchmark source files
Only one source writer is active at a time
A failed writer or build restores the previous verified green snapshot

nodes.assignment: Read the seeded green tree, inventory remaining sorries in Player.lean, Functor.lean, Small.lean, and the instRepr regression. Send a ranked declaration list to Root and finish without editing source.
nodes.guide: Prefer exact declaration names, dependency impact, and focused build commands. Do not propose risky Dyadic, Surreal, Classes, Order, Pow, or Ordinal edits.

nodes.assignment: Coordinate the serial writer chain, preserve the seeded score floor, and report each Runtime gate outcome. Do not edit source or submit.
nodes.guide: Wait for children, insist on one small proof batch per writer, and stop a route after its Runtime build is rejected.

nodes.assignment: Starting from the recovered green proofs, solve a small set of remaining high-impact sorries in Player.lean and Functor.lean. Do not rewrite already solved declarations. Run focused builds and finish so Runtime can execute the authoritative full build.
nodes.guide: Use short existing lemmas and preserve every declaration signature. Make no edits outside the two owned files.

nodes.assignment: After the Player and Functor candidate is accepted or restored, solve only remaining easy sorries in Mathlib/Small.lean. Preserve signatures, run the focused build, and finish for Runtime validation.
nodes.guide: Do not touch Dyadic or any Game or Surreal file. Prefer one minimal proof batch over broad rewriting.

nodes.assignment: Inspect and repair only the known IGame.Domineering.instRepr declaration regression in Game/Specific/Domineering.lean. If no signature-preserving repair is justified, make no source change and report evidence.
nodes.guide: One regression, one minimal patch. Do not broaden scope to IGame.lean, Classes.lean, or Order.lean.

nodes.assignment: Use the remaining budget for one final conservative pass over Player.lean and Functor.lean. Keep the current green proofs intact and attempt only declarations with a short, locally supported proof.
nodes.guide: Stop after a focused build failure or two unproductive targets. Runtime, not this agent, decides whether the batch is accepted.

nodes.assignment: After every writer is terminal and Runtime has accepted or restored each batch, run a read-only full build and inspect git diff for out-of-scope changes. Report whether the current tree matches the last Runtime-verified green state.
nodes.guide: Do not edit or submit. Report exact commands, exit codes, changed files, and any unresolved risk to Root.
